subject: wo-exp-pri
title: (R)WO.EXP.PRI.------T.C.IMP.
description: Diagram in EXT.F(II)-25, on the page where Braxton diagnoses the seventies' fragmentation: 'the music scene can be broken into several different cult-like movements, and few groups seem to have any respect or affinity for what is perceived to be outside initiations. This was the state of alternative creativity in the seventies.' (R)WO-EXP-PRI — the *reality* of world expansion principle — is crossed with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). The structural pairing is sharp: real world-expansion (not the concept) crossed with time-continuum implications asks what world-expansion would actually require to operate across cycles, given the seventies' cult-like atomization. TR (transformation) branches from the main line and opens into LK-IMP (linkage implications) → PRI-INFO (principle information) → SP-DY (spiritual dynamics). DYM-SEP (dynamic separation) branches from the main line and opens into IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism) → RE-ST (restructuralism) → GRAD (gradualism) → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). RE-DOC (redocumentation) is drawn below DYM-SEP without a line of its own.
